## Gap ID
OPS-001

## Source
gap-analysis-operational

## Description
OSimFlow has no distributed log aggregation. Per-sample stdout/stderr files are written locally to `${outdir}/work/sim/<sample_id>/`. There is no centralized:
- Log streaming
- Log aggregation across workers
- Centralized log search

openstudio-server aggregates all logs via Docker's logging driver to a central store.

## Evidence
- `osimflow/work.py` — local stdout/stderr files
- No log aggregation configuration
- No centralized logging backend

## Severity
Major

## Recommended Mitigation
- Phase 1: Add `--log-aggregation-url` flag for remote log sink
- Phase 2: Integrate with CloudWatch Logs / Elasticsearch / Datadog
- Phase 3: Add per-campaign log search UI

## Labels
gap-analysis, operational, logging, major
